new_standards.standard_text: For the three should_fix items whose criterion reads '<X>_unverified → verified or corrected/amended' (REV-M1-17 transcription of the 0.0949 SD; REV-M1-26 Pulletz threshold; REV-M1-27 Zhao indices), the 'verified' branch has no manuscript-visible evidence pattern when the check confirms the existing text: an unchanged sentence or table cell is indistinguishable, in a revision-blind reading of the manuscript alone, from an unchecked one. Advisory operational note: the verifier will accept as evidence of verification a manuscript or supporting-information surface that lets the value be recomputed (per-seed values in S1 Table) or that states the check (a footnote or clause), and otherwise will have to rely on the author-side surfaces that only Phase 2B may read. This does not add an acceptance requirement and cannot change any verdict.
new_standards.why_not_in_round1: Round 1 wrote these criteria as outcome pairs ('verified or corrected') without specifying what in the manuscript shows the 'verified' outcome; the gap only appears when the criterion is operationalized as a manuscript evidence pattern under revision-blind reading.
